QuestInfo.name: Mai's Training
QuestInfo.0: Mai in Maple Island seems like a Martial -Art specialist, who can train the beginners to boost up the strength...
QuestInfo.1:
I decided to get trained under the Famous Sword-Master, Mai, in Amherst. I guess hunting the weakest monsters is a good idea. Should I hunt Snail, Blue Snail, and Shroom in order?

 Ah, Mai told me to meet with #p20002# in Southperry and try training together...
QuestInfo.2: Mai trained me, and I feel I'm a lot stronger.

0.0: Hmmm ... you look like you can use a little bit of my guidance. Hahaha, do not be afraid. It just looks like you're not used to this place, yet. Is it your first time here? You may run into some unwanted trouble by just wandering around not knowing a thing about this place. What you need more than anything is FOCUS. What do you think? Do you want me to train you?

yes.0: Hmmm, alright. It's very simple actually. All you need to do right now is to hunt the monsters. And don't think a simple act like hunting won't be of much help. You'll be assigned to do a few tasks through me, and you'll ultimately end up growing as a traveler.
yes.1: You already know how to hunt monsters? No way. Impossible. You're a newbie.
yes.2:
Look around this town, and you'll run into lots of monsters. The weakest of all is the Snail, a tiny green snail, and it's a piece of cake. The next weakest are the Blue Snails and the Shrooms. My advice to you is to feast on the weaker monsters and level up easily, until it gets to the point where you can handle bigger, stronger, and faster monsters. It's all about understanding your strengths and weaknesses, and using that knowledge to hunt down the right monsters.

yes.3: Oh, and press W to see the World Map and locate Southperry. Go there and meet #p9201199#, and he may have something in store for you. You can take on #p9201199#'s quest while training with me, so I suggest you meet him pronto.

1.0: How was it? Have you been training by taking on the weaker monsters? Let me see ...

mob.0: Hmmm ... I don't think you understood what I told you. You haven't defeated enough number of monsters. You know you can check on your quest progress by pressing Q, right? I suggest you check out the numbers again.
